title: Container Bookings: shipping instruction and VGM cut-offs, grace and late submissions
content:
## Policy clause
For the Container Bookings product line, shipping instructions (SI) and the SOLAS verified gross mass (VGM) must reach the line by the SI cut-off and the VGM cut-off of the allocated sailing.

**Shipping instructions.** Shipping instructions are accepted for the allocated vessel only when they are received no later than the SI cut-off plus the tier's SI grace hours. The grace deadline is the SI cut-off time plus the tier's grace hours, counted as full 60-minute hours in port-of-loading local time, and receipt exactly at the deadline is still inside it. The receipt time and the cut-off are those recorded on the booking. Shipping instructions received after the SI cut-off but inside grace book one late SI fee entry per booking. Received after grace, they are not accepted for that sailing and the booking is rolled to the next sailing as a customer roll under the roll rules, with no late fee for the missed sailing.

**Verified gross mass.** A VGM received after the VGM cut-off but no later than the VGM cut-off plus the tier's VGM grace hours books one late VGM fee entry. No container is loaded without a verified gross mass, so a VGM later than grace also leads to a customer roll.

**Recording.** Every late submission is recorded as an entry. A late documentation fee may be booked only while the booking is confirmed, equipment released or gated in. Documents received on time book nothing.

## Time boundary cases (hypothetical grace)
*Hypothetical SI grace of 10 hours and SI cut-off at 12:00 on 3 May, port-of-loading local time, for illustration only:*
| SI receipt | Judgement |
|---|---|
| 11:30 on 3 May | on time; nothing is booked |
| 12:00 on 3 May | not after the cut-off; on time |
| 22:00 on 3 May | exactly at the grace deadline; inside grace, late SI entry |
| 22:01 on 3 May | after grace; not accepted for that sailing, customer roll, no late fee for it |

## Retired wording
The following two statements of this policy are **no longer in force** and have been superseded by the current basis for recording late documents:
- the former statement that a late entry is recorded at 0.00 while the customer's count of late documentation fees over the trailing 365 days is below the free late-document allowance, and at the full fee otherwise;
- the former statement that a late VGM books one entry of the per-container late VGM fee multiplied by the booking's container count.
